projections.source_time_basis: Retained HYCOM January/July15,2022 00Z snapshots; no new provider fields or independent observations.
projections.projection_gate: Interior maximum of complete finite20–500m northward integral; resolved primary10cm/s lower contour.
projections.branch_scope: Partial northward West Spitsbergen slope-current corridor from 73 N editorial Barents-departure approach to 79.6 N pre-branching gate. Exclude upstream Norwegian Atlantic routes, Barents inflow, offshore Front Current feeder, recirculation, shelf/fjord intrusions and downstream Svalbard/Yermak/Yermak Pass branches as target identities. Broad northward maxima do not independently resolve these branches or Atlantic Water membership. Source 1,000 m glider limit is not a current bottom; 20–500 m averaged velocities and source water-mass thresholds are not adopted as model layer boundaries. Spitsbergen Atlantic naming is not merged. This separately labeled20–500m diagnostic permits subsurface flow without surface qualification. It does not establish thermal Atlantic Water membership or replace the original surface-screened cases.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep every original fixed-longitude section in declared downstream order. Use selected native model positions;where no column qualifies,use actualnativewrappedlongitude and the declaredlatitude-gate midpoint only as an explicit unresolved reference geometry placeholder with no sampled position or depth. ShortestWGS84legs connect adjacentoriginal references,including across180/-180. Assume linear lowerdepth and paired modelspan only between neighboring original supported nodes;never skip,extrapolate or fill from an alternate cutoff. Distances are reference geometry,not measured current lengths.
